name: Westbound Panama Canal "Land & Sea" Roasted Venison Loin & Warm Olive Loaf
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Westbound Panama Canal (Land and Sea Menu)
whyItWorks: Venison loin is one of the leanest red meats available (even leaner than beef tenderloin), making it exceptionally easy on bile-acid digestion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the roasted venison loin with jus on the side and mashed potatoes; pick around whole olives in the freshly baked bread loaf if flaring.
watchOuts: Skip red wine/berry reduction if it contains whole seeds or heavy black pepper
